title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Hints and lenses that follow your edits
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.5 is the third pass of the display sweep, this time on what the editor shows inline: two caches that outlived the files they described, a hover reading the wrong annotation, a swatch that stopped following the cursor, a history that sorted every jump destination last, and two settings whose toggle did nothing.

highlights.title: Hints that follow a rename
highlights.description: Parameter name and inferred type hints were cached per symbol for the whole session: rename a parameter, save, and every call site kept the old name until a reload. The file watcher now evicts them, and the "N usages" lens of a symbol declared elsewhere updates when a call is added in another file.

highlights.title: The right @Deprecated message
highlights.description: Two deprecated declarations within eight lines of each other made the hover show the upper one's message and ReplaceWith on the lower symbol. It now reads the annotation glued to the hovered symbol, and a signature read from an unsaved file is located by name rather than by a stale line.

highlights.title: Faster R.string hover
highlights.description: Two quick hovers each re-read up to 4000 files, and every file went through span extraction even without the key. One shared load, files without the key skipped, cancellation honoured, unsaved editor text used over the disk snapshot.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Keeps the hex colour swatch following the active editor in a split view; it used to stick to the last visible editor until the next switch.
Sorts jump destinations correctly in Recent Locations: the refined entry lost its timestamp and every destination sorted last.
Makes the kotlinJump.gradleTaskLens and kotlinJump.kmpTargetBadges toggles take effect immediately instead of on the next edit.
Gives each inlay hint pass its own call regex; a shared one duplicated or dropped hints on first paint with two editors open.
